channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: Audi lowers revenue forecast
item.description: German automaker Audi has lowered its financial forecast for 2026 after weaker sales in China and North America hurt its earnings during the first nine months of the year.

item.title: Flagship arrival
item.description: Lynk & Co has introduced its flagship SUV to Philippine buyers with the arrival of the 900, a six-seat plug-in hybrid priced at P4.28 million. The model made its local debut on 6 November at Sta. Elena Golf and Country Estate in Santa Rosa, Laguna.

item.title: Inday Rider
item.description: When I sat next to Arlyne Diaz at a motorcycle event, she told me she rode big bikes and worked in real estate.

item.title: Geely briefs EX2 owners about EV care
item.description: Geely Motor Philippines brought together 20 owners of its all-electric EX2 in Alabang to discuss vehicle ownership, warranty procedures and after-sales support.

item.title: Nissan Navara Pro goes hybrid
item.description: Nissan Philippines has introduced the Navara Pro Plug-in Hybrid, its first pickup here with a rechargeable battery and gasoline engine. Launched on 6 November, the new model is offered in VL and LE 4x4 variants, with introductory prices starting at P2.448 million.

item.title: Foot spa on wheels
item.description: When I came across a report about a Chinese carmaker developing a foot bath for its vehicles, the first thing that came to mind was, “Is this for real?”

item.description: The Auto Focus Multi-Brand Test Drive Festival returns to the SM Mall of Asia Concert Grounds this Thursday, November 12 to Sunday, November 15. Festival hours are from 11 AM to 9 PM every day. Read More »

item.title: Lando Norris Wins Brazilian Grand Prix from Pole in Intense Mixed Conditions
item.description: Verstappen nearly grabbed a win from a new grid position, driving from 21st to second, but Lando Norris and McLaren made all the right decisions to keep Norris out front at the end.
